name: The files of accounts changed
description: /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow or /etc/group has another SHA-256 than at the previous collection. useradd, usermod, passwd and userdel do it, so most are expected; a change without a matching account event (password changed, account deleted) is edited by hand.
remediation: Check the account events of the same time: a change that is not explained by them was made by hand.
